problem: Isolated build outputs and their verified state can be deleted while a persistent checkout retains invalidated state, forcing repeated compilation.
invariant: Publish a durable atomic pointer to a complete verified build before independent downstream work; protect that worktree during cleanup and revalidate provenance on every reuse.
failure_behavior: Partial publication preserves the old pointer. Invalidated state never becomes green through selection. Malformed pointers block cleanup. Generated outputs and verified metadata remain together. Reject links/junctions before descent; retry only read-only Git metadata on Windows and propagate locks/ACL failures.
